Assist software engineers through our dedicated "Ask Infrastructure" channel, troubleshooting deployment issues, upgrading dependencies, and embedding DevOps culture across engineering scrums. Observability, SRE & Incident Management : Enhance system telemetry and alerting across Grafana, Prometheus, and the ELK stack. Participate in an on-call rotation to maintain platform availability, with a structured 3-month onboarding runway before joining the active schedule. What You Bring To The Role Cloud & Infrastructure as Code: Proven track record running production systems on AWS via CLI/API and building modular infrastructure using Terraform. Containers & Orchestration: Strong practical experience with Docker containerization and Kubernetes management (EKS). CI/CD & Automation: Deep understanding of the software development lifecycle, Git workflows, and build/release automation using Jenkins, Harness, or GitHub Actions. Scripting & Tooling: Proficiency in at least one scripting or programming language (Python, Go, or Bash) for infrastructure automation. Innovation is in our blood We’re pioneers in our industry Our curiosity is insatiable We bring the best ideas to life. We Do What We Say We’re accountable for our work and actions Excellence comes as standard We’re open, honest and kind, always.
